<!-- Keep routine fixes short. Shared process: https://github.com/bardphysicslab/engineering-standards/blob/main/development-workflow.md -->

## Goal and boundaries
<!-- Result; exclusions. Find/reuse an existing issue and project board first. -->

## Baseline and architecture
<!-- What exists? Relevant architecture/contract and owners; preserved invariants or proposed departure. A small fix needs only a sentence. -->

## Decisions and authorized scope
<!-- Link accepted decision entries, or list open choices. For material choices use Context, Decision, Alternatives, Consequences, Acceptance; dated exact decision/approval goes in an issue comment. Do not invent approval. -->

## Acceptance criteria
<!-- Observable result(s), not just “tests pass.” -->

## Owner, dependencies and next step
<!-- Implementation/review owner; blockers; existing board. An idea is not implementation authorization. -->
